visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A pair of hands uses a large chef's knife to cut a round, sesame-topped pancake into segments on a dark wooden cutting board. The pancake appears thin and crispy. (2) A close-up shot shows a hand picking up a triangular slice, showcasing the thin, flaky layers and the dark red bean filling inside. (3) The scene shifts to a metal bowl where white flour is being stirred vigorously with a pair of metal chopsticks. (4) Hot water is poured from a pitcher into the flour, and the mixture is stirred until it forms a flaky, snowflake-like texture. (5) Liquid oil is added, and the hands press and fold the mixture into a cohesive dough ball within the metal bowl. (6) A white cloth is placed over the bowl to allow the dough to rest in a clean kitchen setting. (7) The dough is then divided into three equal portions on a white marble countertop. (8) One portion of dough is rolled out into a circle using a marble rolling pin. (9) A ball of smooth red bean paste is placed in the center of the dough, which is then gathered and pinched shut. (10) The filled dough ball is pressed into a plate covered with white sesame seeds. (11) The sesame-coated ball is rolled out thin into a large circle roughly 20cm in diameter on a floured surface. (12) Multiple prepared uncooked pancakes are shown being wrapped individually in plastic wrap for storage. (13) A pancake is placed into a hot cast-iron skillet on an induction stove with a thin layer of oil. (14) Using a black spatula, the pancake is flipped, revealing a golden-brown, crispy surface with toasted sesame seeds. (15) The cooked pancake is returned to the wooden board and sliced into six triangular pieces with the knife. (16) The final shot shows the crispy slices held up to the camera, emphasizing their texture and red bean filling.
